returns.count: The active support count after excluding stale ineligible receipts.

returns.record: The stored public veto process record.

returns.active: Whether the person currently has an active veto recorded.

returns.remaining: The number of additional supports required.

castPublicVeto(bytes32).notice: Casts a headcount-based public veto on an eligible legislation measure.

citizenEligibilityPolicy().notice: Returns the configured citizen eligibility policy address.

currentPublicVetoSupportCount(bytes32).notice: Returns the currently eligible active support count for a measure.

eligibleCitizenCount().notice: Returns the current number of unique citizens in good standing who may participate in public veto.

getPublicVetoRecord(bytes32).notice: Returns the stored public veto process record for a measure.

hasActivePublicVeto(bytes32,bytes32).notice: Returns true when a person currently has an active public veto recorded for a measure.

identityRegistry().notice: Returns the configured identity registry used for person-level headcount tracking.

legislationRegistry().notice: Returns the configured legislation registry address.

previewVetoId(bytes32).notice: Returns the deterministic public veto identifier for a measure.

remainingRepealSupport(bytes32).notice: Returns the remaining support needed to reach the repeal threshold for a measure.

removePublicVeto(bytes32).notice: Removes a previously cast public veto before repeal finalizes.

repealThreshold().notice: Returns the immutable headcount threshold required for repeal.
